decisions.decision: The APDC agreed to inform the town manager that removal of the Brooks House would not be allowed without stipulations: it stays under APDC CTA jurisdiction, stays in the town, and reverts to the town if conditions are not met in time.
decisions.quote: the apdc agreed to inform lemieux that removal of the building would not be allowed without stipulations

decisions.decision: The APDC concluded it had better explore other options to preserve historic properties owned by the town.
decisions.quote: the apdc concluded that it had better explore other options to preserve historic properties owned by the town.

decisions.decision: Corcoran suggested a contractor's estimate for the roof, parapet and downspouts of the Old Primary School; McGrath agreed to seek DPW permission for a contractor inspection and for volunteers to clear vegetation.
decisions.quote: mcgrath agreed, and will get permission from the dpw for the contractor to inspect

decisions.decision: LaVeck will speak with Town Counsel about the APDC charter and whether getting a contractor estimate would overreach its authority.
decisions.quote: laveck intended to speak with town counsel.

decisions.decision: Dwyer will present various fonts for the APD road signs at the next meeting.
decisions.quote: dwyer proposed to present various fonts to choose from for the next meeting.

decisions.decision: Dwyer agreed to review the video from the joint workshop with the Select Board and record details on selling the Brooks House for use as a private residence.
decisions.quote: he agreed to review the video from the joint workshop with the select board

decisions.decision: McGrath agreed to talk to Mr. Burney about the Brooks House.
decisions.quote: mcgrath agreed to talk to mr. burney regarding the same.

decisions.decision: LaVeck will learn more about the Capital Planning Committee funding process in the coming months.
decisions.quote: he will learn more about the process in the coming months.
